definitions.label: 1 = spoof (synthetic or converted), 0 = bona fide
definitions.FAR: share of spoof clips accepted as bona fide (missed clones)
definitions.FRR: share of bona fide clips flagged as synthetic (false alarms on real people)
definitions.frr_at_far5: FRR when the threshold is set so that FAR = 5 %
definitions.calibration: Platt scaling fitted on dev (seen generators/speakers), applied to test
definitions.bands: chosen on dev: p_hi = max(0.8, 98th pct of dev bona fide); p_lo = min(0.2, 5th pct of dev spoofs); inconclusive in between; quality-gate failures are inconclusive in the service
